brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished the Mahmiyat settlement in Deir Ballout, west of Salfit, the Ma'an news agency reported. The structures were razed in an operation carried out by military bulldozers.

The demolition marks the latest in a series of settlement removals in the area. Deir Ballout lies in the northern West Bank, where Israeli forces have conducted periodic demolition operations targeting Palestinian structures and informal settlements.
title: Israeli bulldozers demolish Mahmiyat settlement in western Salfit
